components.name: DataGrid
components.introduction: Native ReUI data grid with caller-owned TanStack state and columns.
components.guidance: Create a controller with useTable({ features: dataGridFeatures, data, columns, getRowId, state, ...handlers }). Compose DataGridTable inside DataGridScrollArea. Use DataGridColumnHeader for sorting, DataGridPagination for pagination, and DataGridContainer or Frame for the surface. For row selection, enableRowSelection, provide stable domain IDs through getRowId, and compose DataGridTableRowSelectAll (no props) and DataGridTableRowSelect in the selection column. Client pagination uses zero-based state.pagination.pageIndex. Server pagination also requires manualPagination: true and rowCount: total in useTable; recordCount alone does not configure the table. Keep data loading and mutations in the View. Use isLoading for skeleton rows; emptyMessage accepts an Empty component with a recovery action or a request error with Retry.

components.name: Filters
components.introduction: Native ReUI filter builder with caller-owned query state.
components.guidance: Initialize with createFilterQuery(). Use flattenFilterConditions(query) for flat conjunctions; callers own query evaluation.

components.name: Frame
components.justification: Composes ReUI Frame sections behind flat title, description, action, and footer props with owned panel spacing.
components.introduction: A structured surface with an optional header and footer around one content panel.
components.guidance: Pass title, description, and a right-aligned action directly. The header is omitted when all three are absent; action alone creates a full-width header. Pass footer as JSX and panel content as children. Use padding="none" for edge-to-edge tables.

components.name: Input
components.introduction: A props-based input with native DOM events and internally associated labels and validation feedback.
components.guidance: Use label, description, and error instead of Field composition. Box owns width; Stack and Grid arrange controls. Validation and submission remain caller-owned; runtime failures belong to the error boundary. Use native date, time, and file input types. File inputs remain uncontrolled and files must be validated on the server.

properties.description: Use "any" for decimals.

properties.name: onChange
properties.description: DOM event; read event.currentTarget.value, or event.currentTarget.files for file inputs.

properties.name: value

properties.name: defaultValue
properties.description: Initial uncontrolled value.

properties.name: accept
properties.description: File picker hint; validate file types on the server.

properties.name: multiple
properties.description: Allows multiple file selections.

components.justification: Owns field labeling, validation feedback, and fixed presentation while retaining the installed native input.

components.name: Textarea
components.introduction: A props-based textarea with native DOM events and internally associated field feedback.

components.name: Map
components.justification: Preserves native mapcn composition while containing WebGL initialization failures and retry within the map region.
components.introduction: Native mapcn map container for composable geographic layers.
components.guidance: Place Map inside a Box with an explicit height. Use blank for a transparent basemap with no street tiles, then compose MapGeoJSON inside it. The map follows the UI theme automatically. Coordinates use longitude, latitude. The bundled worker stays local; external map resources remain limited to the approved CARTO origins.

components.name: MapGeoJSON
components.introduction: Native mapcn GeoJSON fill and outline layer composed inside Map.
components.guidance: Render MapGeoJSON inside Map. Use Map blank for a boundary-only map. Pass parsed GeoJSON from your Solution to avoid remote source dependencies. Paint options use MapLibre expressions, and interaction callbacks retain the native mapcn event payload.

components.name: MapControls
components.introduction: Mapcn zoom, compass, browser location, and fullscreen controls.
components.guidance: Compose MapControls inside Map. Locate requests browser permission only when clicked and requires a secure context. Location and fullscreen remain subject to browser and iframe permission policies.

components.name: StreetMap
components.justification: Owns parent-controlled sizing, provider restrictions, accessible naming, and local failure recovery around mapcn.
components.introduction: One themed street map combining optional locations, routes, clusters, and connections.
components.guidance: Pass locations, routes, clusters, and connections together to render them on a single map. onSelectLocation handles location markers and individual unclustered points. Place in a Box with an explicit height. Coordinates use longitude, latitude. CARTO styles, tiles, sprites, and glyphs use fixed allowlisted endpoints without credentials. The worker is bundled locally. View code cannot provide arbitrary style URLs. Mouse-wheel zoom is enabled on interactive maps.

components.name: MarkerMap
components.justification: Builds accessible markers and text popups from caller-owned data while keeping mapcn composition inside the component.
components.introduction: Named locations with accessible marker buttons and text popups.
components.guidance: Pass data as MapMarker objects. IDs must be unique. Marker coordinates use longitude, latitude. Size with Box. Supports the same map options as StreetMap.

properties.name: data
properties.description: Locations with id, coordinates, label, and optional description.

components.name: RouteMap
components.justification: Validates and renders route collections through mapcn without requiring View-owned layer composition or external routing.
components.introduction: Route lines drawn from supplied longitude and latitude coordinates.
components.guidance: Pass data as MapRoute objects with unique IDs and at least two coordinate pairs. Route geometry comes from your Solution; no routing service is called. Size with Box. Supports the same map options as StreetMap.

components.name: ClusterMap
components.justification: Converts named locations to clustered GeoJSON and maps selected features back to caller-owned records.
components.introduction: Nearby locations grouped into expandable clusters.
components.guidance: Pass the same MapMarker data used by MarkerMap. Clicking a cluster zooms in; onSelect receives individual locations. Size with Box. Supports the same map options as StreetMap.

components.name: ArcMap
components.justification: Validates geographic connection data and owns mapcn arc composition and selection.
components.introduction: Curved connections between geographic origins and destinations.
components.guidance: Pass MapArc data with unique IDs, from, and to coordinates. Size with Box. Supports the same map options as StreetMap.

Native div attributes and events are supported without refs or styling overrides.

components.name: Dialog

Configure width and height directly because the dialog is portaled; use height="auto" for content-sized dialogs. Fullscreen takes precedence over width and height. Viewport constraints and body scrolling remain component-owned. Set dismissible=false during noninterruptible work and close through controlled open state when complete. Validation, submission, and pending state remain caller-owned. Use useConfirm for destructive confirmations.

components.name: FormProvider
components.introduction: Shares React Hook Form methods with nested controls.
components.guidance: Call useForm(schema, { defaultValues, action }) and use form.submit for automatic validation and scoped multipart submission. Editing defaults stay explicit and do not need to satisfy the schema before submission. Parsed scalar values become text; files remain binary; arrays repeat field names; null and undefined are omitted, not treated as clearing a value. Nested objects and nonfinite numbers are rejected before transport. Submission failures populate formState.errors.root and preserve the draft. Standard methods remain available for local or custom forms. Spread methods onto FormProvider only when descendants need useFormContext. Validate and authorize mutations on the server.

components.name: Controller

components.guidance: Pass field props to Input or Textarea, with label and error={fieldState.error?.message}. For selection controls, pass value={field.value}, onValueChange={field.onChange}, and ref={field.ref}; boolean controls use checked and onCheckedChange. Use form.reset() to restore defaults. Field layout and accessible feedback are internal to each control.

properties.description: Registered form value path.

properties.name: control
properties.description: The control returned by useForm.

properties.name: rules
properties.description: Field validation when not using a schema resolver.

properties.name: render
properties.description: Renders the controlled input and its feedback.

components.name: Functions
components.introduction: Scoped Solution requests and navigation capabilities.
components.guidance: Requests and scoped navigation target the current Solution. External HTTP(S) navigation requires user activation. Server routes own authorization and business rules.

members.name: navigate(path)
members.description: Navigates within the current Solution using a scoped path, or opens an HTTP(S) URL in a new tab. External URLs require user activation and open without an opener or referrer.

members.name: request(path, options)
members.description: Requests a Solution operation and returns its data. Options support the HTTP method, JSON, form data, and binary responses. Successful writes automatically refresh cached View data. Failed HTTP requests reject with an Error containing an optional numeric status and a bounded client-facing message.

components.justification: Provides capabilities scoped to the current Solution, including requests, downloads, and navigation.

components.name: Grid

components.guidance: A numeric columns value keeps one column through 768px. Use an object for explicit responsive counts: base, sm (640px), md (768px), lg (1024px), and xl (1280px); omitted breakpoints inherit the preceding count. Padding uses theme spacing units, like Stack, with inline and block overrides. GridItem spans apply above 768px and remain full-width at 768px or less. Accepts native div attributes and events without styling overrides.

components.name: Hooks
components.introduction: React hooks for local state, synchronization, and loading Solution data.
components.guidance: Use controlled state for local interaction. Effects should synchronize with external systems, not duplicate derived state.

members.name: useForm(schema, options?)
members.description: React Hook Form state with automatic Zod validation. Pass defaultValues and an action endpoint, then use form.submit for duplicate-protected multipart submission of parsed values. Scalars become text, files remain binary, arrays repeat field names, and null values are omitted; nested objects are rejected. Failures populate formState.errors.root and preserve the draft. Native handleSubmit remains available for custom submissions.

members.name: useSubmit(path, options)
members.description: Returns an awaitable, duplicate-protected scoped submission function accepting FormData for standalone actions. Use useForm(schema, { action }) for forms. Successful writes refresh cached View data before onSuccess. Unhandled failures reject.

members.name: useState(initial)
members.description: Returns the current state and a setter. Pass a value or an initializer function; updates can use the previous state.

members.name: useEffect(effect, dependencies)
members.description: Synchronizes with external systems after rendering. Return a cleanup function to release timers or subscriptions. Include every reactive value used by the effect in its dependencies.

members.name: useMemo(factory, dependencies)
members.description: Caches a calculated value until its dependencies change. Use it for expensive calculations, not required application state.

members.name: useRef(initial)
members.description: Returns a stable object with a mutable current property. Changing current does not trigger a render.

members.name: useApi(path)
members.description: Returns Solution data and an awaitable invalidator scoped to the full request path. The renderer handles initial loading, errors, and retry.

members.name: useConfirm()
members.description: Returns show(options), hide(), isOpen, and element; render element once in JSX. Options require title, actionLabel, and onAction: () => void | Promise<void>. Optional description, cancelLabel (default Cancel), and actionVariant: default | destructive (default default). Cancel receives initial focus; Escape cancels and backdrop clicks do not dismiss. Async actions show loading, prevent duplicate submissions, and close only after success. Failure keeps the dialog open for retry; scoped request errors are reported by the host, other errors appear inside the dialog. While pending, Cancel, Escape, show(), and hide() are ignored. Example: const confirmation = useConfirm(); confirmation.show({ title: 'Conferma variante A', cancelLabel: 'Annulla', actionLabel: 'Continua', onAction: async () => { await request('/api/variants', { method: 'POST', json: { variant: 'A' } }); } }); Render {confirmation.element} beside the trigger Button.

components.justification: Exposes React hooks and scoped Solution data-loading capabilities to isolated Views.

The download prop is a native anchor attribute, not a scoped file operation. Choose styling props instead of className or style.

groups.Runtime: Local state, Solution data, requests, and scoped navigation.
groups.Action: Operations and navigation through buttons, links, and action menus.
groups.Display: Records, text, metadata, status, progress, and file previews.
groups.Form: Collecting and submitting input through forms and field components.
groups.Charts: Visualizing trends, category comparisons, part-to-whole breakdowns, and directed flows.
groups.Maps: Street maps, named locations, routes, clusters, geographic regions, and origin-destination connections.
groups.Layouts: Arranging content, panels, navigation, dialogs, tabs, and steps.

patterns.name: Confirmation
patterns.description: Ask for Continue or Cancel before a scoped Solution operation, without managing dialog-open state.
steps: Call useConfirm() at the top level and render its element once beside the trigger Button.
Call show({ title, actionLabel, cancelLabel, onAction }) from the trigger. Description is optional; use translated labels when needed.
Await request(path, { method: 'POST', json: payload }) inside onAction. Successful actions dismiss automatically; failures stay open for retry.

patterns.name: Data table
patterns.description: Present searchable records using data-driven rows and explicit query state.
steps: Load records with the documented Hooks API and keep search/filter state local.
Define Table columns and row actions using supported props; apply filtering or pagination on the server when needed.
Use Empty with a title and optional description and actions when there are no matching records.

patterns.name: Editing form
patterns.description: Collect intent through named fields and persist changes through a validated Solution route.
steps: Use the documented useForm hook with an action endpoint and explicit defaults from the record being edited; use FormProvider when descendants need form context.
Choose field components that match the server schema and use documented names and value contracts.
Submit to a Solution route that validates input and enforces authorization; display its documented success or error state.

patterns.name: Approval queue
patterns.description: Show pending work and make the next authorized action clear.
steps: Load pending records with the documented Hooks API and display their states as Table rows with Badge values.
Add explicit approve/reject actions through Button callbacks and scoped requests.
Enforce transitions and permissions on the Solution server, then refresh the queue after a successful action.
